raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- test_amd_csa_paged.py: decode summary scores, region selection and gated sparse decode attention against FP32 references, on the TP1 (4x16) and TP8 (1x8) head layouts, for single-token decode and 4-row MTP verify, with BF16 and FP8 KV.
- test_amd_model.py: engine test on the reduced registry checkpoint (top-k 16, FP8 KV, block size 32, 300-token chunked prefill) that runs scored prefill and sparse decode end to end, checks that the scored-prefill warmup runs, and compares decode logprobs against a teacher-forced re-prefill.
- test_amd_fp8_kv_init.py: removed, the engine test covers the same FP8 KV and block-size check.

Follow-up to #61837. Most of the ROCm Step5 tests that came with it mock out the code they cover or only check dispatch, so nothing ran the CSA decode chain against a reference or drove the model through the engine. The kernel test is the numerical check: scores, scale, masks, paging and the gate against FP32. The engine test makes sure the real path runs through vLLM. With dummy weights its logits are nearly flat, so a decode wiring bug and a harmless rounding difference across GPUs both move a logprob by one bf16 step. Its logprob tolerance (1e-2) is therefore only a guard against gross breakage, which the docstring says.

On MI355X the Step5 CI step (`pytest -v -s models/step5` plus the Step5 `test_initialization` case), on this branch merged with main, passed 12/12 runs. Both files run in the existing Step5 CI step.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to draft this change. Every line was reviewed by the submitter.

     for row, length in enumerate(lengths.tolist()):
         assert torch.equal(fine_scores[row, :length], coarse_scores[row, :length])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("groups", "heads_per_group", "query_len", "kv_fp8"),
+    [(4, 16, 1, False), (1, 8, 4, True)],
+    ids=["tp1_decode_bf16_kv", "tp8_verify_fp8_kv"],
+)
+def test_decode_selects_and_attends_over_summaries(
+    groups: int, heads_per_group: int, query_len: int, kv_fp8: bool
+):
+    """Decode and MTP verify chain summary scores, top-k and gated attention as
+    step5_csa_attention does, at the TP1 and TP8 head layouts. The 70-token
+    request selects all history; the 1100-token one has more regions than
+    top-k and than one 128-region score tile."""
+    from vllm.models.step5.common.ops.sparse_decode_attention import (
+        sparse_decode_splits,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.step5.common.ops.sparse_indexer_scores import (
+        decode_summary_scores,
+    )
+
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    dim, topk, indexer_heads = 192, 16, 4
+    seq_lens = [70, 1100]
+    tokens = len(seq_lens) * query_len
+    rows = tokens * groups
+    heads = groups * heads_per_group
+    fp8 = torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    kv_dtype = current_platform.fp8_dtype() if kv_fp8 else None
+
+    pos = torch.tensor(
+        [s - query_len + i for s in seq_lens for i in range(query_len)],
+        device=DEVICE,
+    )
+    req = torch.arange(len(seq_lens), device=DEVICE).repeat_interleave(query_len)
+    means = [
+        torch.randn((-(-s // REGION), PROXY), device=DEVICE).to(fp8).view(torch.uint8)
+        for s in seq_lens
+    ]
+    mean, summary_table = _paged(means, 384 // REGION)
+    # The indexer stores groups outermost and pads its 4 heads per group to 8.
+    q8 = torch.randn((groups, tokens, 8, PROXY), device=DEVICE).to(fp8)
+    q8 = q8.transpose(0, 1)
+    w = torch.rand((groups, tokens, 8), device=DEVICE)
+    w[..., indexer_heads:] = 0
+    w = w.transpose(0, 1)
+
+    scores, meta = decode_summary_scores(
+        q8,
+        w,
+        mean,
+        summary_table,
+        torch.arange(tokens, device=DEVICE),
+        torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE),
+        summary_table.shape[1] * mean.shape[1],
+        num_sms=current_platform.num_compute_units(),
+        row_groups=groups,
+        query_len=query_len,
+    )
+    row_pos = pos.repeat_interleave(groups)
+    assert torch.equal(meta.positions, row_pos)
+    assert torch.equal(meta.topk_lengths.long(), row_pos // REGION)
+    q8_ref, w_ref, scores_ref = q8.float().cpu(), w.cpu(), scores.cpu()
+    for row in range(rows):
+        t, g = divmod(row, groups)
+        live = int(pos[t]) // REGION + 1
+        keys = means[int(req[t])][:live].view(fp8).float().cpu()
+        want = (keys @ q8_ref[t, g].T).relu() @ w_ref[t, g]
+        torch.testing.assert_close(scores_ref[row, :live], want, atol=5e-3, rtol=5e-3)
+
+    regions = select_regions(
+        scores,
+        meta.current,
+        topk,
+        "per_row",
+        topk_lengths=meta.topk_lengths,
+        sort=False,
+    )
+    want = ref_select(scores.view(tokens, groups, -1), pos, topk).view(rows, -1)
+    for row, (got_row, want_row) in enumerate(zip(regions.cpu(), want)):
+        live = min(int(row_pos[row]) // REGION, topk) + 1
+        assert (got_row[:-live] == -1).all() and (got_row[-live:] >= 0).all()
+        assert sorted(got_row[-live:].tolist()) == sorted(want_row[-live:].tolist())
+
+    shape = (len(seq_lens), max(seq_lens), groups, dim)
+    k = torch.randn(shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE)
+    v = torch.randn(shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE)
+    kq, vq, k, v, k_scale, v_scale = _quant_kv(k, v, kv_dtype)
+    kv_cache, bt = _paged(
+        [torch.cat([kq[r, :s], vq[r, :s]], -1) for r, s in enumerate(seq_lens)], 16
+    )
+    q = torch.randn((tokens, heads, dim), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE)
+    gate = torch.randn((tokens, heads), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE)
+    got = torch.empty_like(q)
+    sparse_decode_attention(
+        q.view(rows, heads_per_group, dim),
+        kv_cache.transpose(1, 2).contiguous(),
+        regions,
+        bt,
+        meta.positions,
+        meta.active,
+        got.view(rows, heads_per_group, dim),
+        scale=dim**-0.5,
+        query_len=query_len,
+        splits=sparse_decode_splits(rows),
+        k_scale=k_scale,
+        v_scale=v_scale,
+        gate=gate,
+    )
+    want = ref_attention(q, k, v, regions.view(tokens, groups, -1), req, pos, dim**-0.5)
+    want *= torch.sigmoid(gate.float().cpu()).unsqueeze(-1)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(got.float().cpu(), want, atol=2e-2, rtol=2e-2)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Step5 CSA on ROCm through the engine, on the reduced registry checkpoint
+with top-k 16 so prompts past 128 tokens reach scored prefill and real decode
+selection.
+
+Dummy weights keep the logits nearly flat, so a decode wiring bug moves a
+logprob by one bf16 rounding step, as harmless rounding differences across
+GPUs do. The logprob check only catches gross breakage. Scores, scale, masks,
+paging and the gate are covered by test_amd_csa_paged.py.
+"""
+
+import random
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm import SamplingParams
+from vllm.inputs import TokensPrompt
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from ..registry import HF_EXAMPLE_MODELS
+from ..utils import dummy_hf_overrides
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_rocm(), reason="Step5 CSA is the ROCm path"
+)
+
+ARCH = "Step5ForConditionalGeneration"
+TOPK = 16
+DECODE_TOKENS = 24
+_LOGPROB_ATOL = 1e-2
+
+
+def tiny_step5(cfg):
+    info = HF_EXAMPLE_MODELS.get_hf_info(ARCH)
+    cfg = dummy_hf_overrides(
+        cfg,
+        model_arch=ARCH,
+        exist_overrides=info.hf_overrides,
+        use_original_num_layers=True,
+    )
+    text = cfg.get_text_config()
+    if (sparse := getattr(text, "sparse_config", None)) is not None:
+        text.sparse_config = {**sparse, "topk": TOPK}
+    return cfg
+
+
+def _prompt(length: int, seed: int) -> list[int]:
+    rng = random.Random(seed)
+    return [rng.randrange(1000, 100000) for _ in range(length)]
+
+
+def test_sparse_prefill_matches_decode(vllm_runner, monkeypatch):
+    """Decode (fused summary update, summary scores, sparse decode attention)
+    must give each sampled token the logprob a chunked teacher-forced re-prefill
+    gives it (ring replay across chunks that split regions, scored prefill,
+    paged sparse attention), on the FP8 KV cache at block size 32. The
+    300-token steps also admit the scored-prefill warmup."""
+    from vllm.models.step5.amd import warmup
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_mi3xx
+
+    if not on_mi3xx():
+        pytest.skip("Step5 on ROCm requires MI300 or MI350")
+    info = HF_EXAMPLE_MODELS.get_hf_info(ARCH)
+    info.check_available_online(on_fail="skip")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING", "0")
+
+    warmed = []
+    run_warmup = warmup.run_step5_scored_prefill_warmup
+
+    def spy(worker, topk):
+        warmed.append(run_warmup(worker, topk))
+        return warmed[-1]
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(warmup, "run_step5_scored_prefill_warmup", spy)
+    prompts = [_prompt(700, 0), _prompt(1003, 1)]
+    with vllm_runner(
+        info.default,
+        load_format="dummy",
+        hf_overrides=tiny_step5,
+        max_model_len=4096,
+        max_num_seqs=4,
+        gpu_memory_utilization=0.8,
+        enable_prefix_caching=False,
+        limit_mm_per_prompt={"image": 0, "video": 0},
+        kv_cache_dtype="fp8",
+        block_size=32,
+        enable_chunked_prefill=True,
+        max_num_batched_tokens=300,
+    ) as runner:
+        cache = runner.llm.llm_engine.vllm_config.cache_config
+        assert (cache.cache_dtype, cache.block_size) == ("fp8", 32)
+        decoded = runner.llm.generate(
+            [TokensPrompt(prompt_token_ids=p) for p in prompts],
+            SamplingParams(
+                temperature=0.0,
+                max_tokens=DECODE_TOKENS,
+                logprobs=0,
+                ignore_eos=True,
+            ),
+        )
+        forced = runner.llm.generate(
+            [
+                TokensPrompt(prompt_token_ids=p + list(o.outputs[0].token_ids))
+                for p, o in zip(prompts, decoded)
+            ],
+            SamplingParams(temperature=0.0, max_tokens=1, prompt_logprobs=0),
+        )
+    assert warmed == [True]
+
+    deltas = []
+    for prompt, dec, ref in zip(prompts, decoded, forced):
+        sample = dec.outputs[0]
+        teacher = ref.prompt_logprobs[len(prompt) :]
+        assert len(teacher) == len(sample.token_ids) == DECODE_TOKENS
+        for token, lp, tlp in zip(sample.token_ids, sample.logprobs, teacher):
+            deltas.append(abs(lp[token].logprob - tlp[token].logprob))
+    worst = max(range(len(deltas)), key=deltas.__getitem__)
+    assert deltas[worst] <= _LOGPROB_ATOL, (
+        f"max |dlogprob| {deltas[worst]:.3e} at request {worst // DECODE_TOKENS}, "
+        f"decode step {worst % DECODE_TOKENS}"
+    )
